status — Is the data current, and what does each source hold: per source its kind, row counts, latest snapshot, latest transaction and whether newer data is waiting to be loaded. source narrows to one source and adds detail. marks: how far a monthly return can be trusted instead: per month end, marked_pct, the share of value marked within five days, weighted by USD value in every currency. Example: {}.

Parameters (all optional):
  source       One source id, for its detail and recent loads.
  verbose      Add the counts of rows no category, type or asset class could be found for.
  marks        Month ends instead of sources. Takes from, to and currency; no source or verbose.
  from         marks only: window start. Default: the first month end.
  to           marks only: window end. Default today.
  currency     marks only: the output currency of value_marked and value_total.
  filter       Conditions, all of which hold: ["value > 1000", "date >= 2025-07", "category not in Rent, Groceries"].
  search       Keep rows with this text in any cell.
  columns      "default", "all", names, or "+add,-remove"; describe(topic=<tool>) lists them.
  sort         Column to sort by; "-" for descending. "-value": the main money column, largest first whatever the sign.
  max_chars    Most characters the result may take (default 16000); the page ends at a row boundary and the last line says how to get the rest.
  limit        Most rows to return (default: as many as fit).
  offset       Rows to skip (default 0).
  format       table | csv | json. Result format (default table).

Columns (* = shown by default; columns=all shows every one):
  silver_source*, kind*, state*, positions*, transactions*, first_snapshot*, latest_snapshot*, latest_transaction*, observed_holdings*, observed_ledger*, last_loaded*, new_data*, uncategorized_spending, uncategorized_income, other_kind, guessed_kind, other_asset_class, no_vehicle
  marks=true: month_end*, marked_pct*, value_marked_USD*, value_total_USD*, quality*

new_data=yes means a load would bring newer data in. state "not loaded" means gold holds nothing from the source yet. marks reads month ends: a low marked_pct says a month's return rests on old marks. A month end with no position has no marked_pct; currency moves value_marked and value_total, never marked_pct.
